title: Stardivers
description: Modpack for the Stardivers Create Aeronautics server
body:
Create Aeronautics has released! Stadivers provides a base experience of **Create Aeronatuics** with **Distant Horizons** and **Terralith**. Create copycats and Cobblestone Generators have also been added. (Oh, and **Computercraft**)
> Perfect when you just want to have something that just works. Or that you can add your own create addons and contents mods to without troubleshooting at getting a good baseline going for a modpack.

Of course at performance stack of mods and clientside QOL have also been added.
Multiplayer ready thanks to **Chunky** and **Open Parties and Claims**

While the official Stardivers servers is whitelisted you can use the provided server version to run your own.

## Mod Highlights:
## - Allurement
- Amplified Nether
- ComputerCraft
- Create
  - **Aeronautics**
  - Big Cannons
  - Cobblestone
  - Deco
  - Railways Navigator
  - Vibrant Vaults
  - Copycats+
  - CC Total Logistics
- Supplimentaries
- Quark
- Terralith (without structures but with Andesite)
- Gravestone Mod
- Lootr
- Chunky (+ Chunky Offline)
- Distant Horizons
- Mending Reworked
- Open Parties and Claims
- Xaeros Map
  - Worldmap
  - Train Map
